summary:
Revision r8 of "Visonaut Audit" is written, built, and checked. The artifact is not published.

Skills that I loaded before the first change: `ariakit-general-workflow`, `ariakit-general-code-style`, `ariakit-ariakit-api-design`. No `ariakit-visonaut-*` skill is installed.

**State of the record.** All 58 decisions are settled, and none is open. I changed no id, status, option, or settledAnswer, and I did not edit `record.json`. The only decision text that I changed is the end of the rationale of D-PERF-01 and D-PERF-03 (checked against `apply.mjs`, which I read and did not run).

**What the document says now.**
- Feedback round 5 settled D-PERF-01, D-PERF-02, and D-PERF-03, each with the recommended option and no note.
- D-PERF-01 and D-PERF-03 are built in the lab. D-PERF-02 is not built: its test comes with the implementation.
- "What still needs your word" keeps 11 items. Item 11 now names the test of D-PERF-02 and keeps the report to Ariakit UI.
- The order-of-work demo has each of the 58 decisions in a step. Step 8 has the 3 answers of round 5.
- The section "Your answers" has 7,794 words of reader text, the same as in r7.

**Facts that I verified myself in `apps/lab`** (not only from the lab report):
- Counted from code: the screenshot list takes one glider prop.

```tsx
// apps/lab/src/explorations/kits/ariakit/list/screenshot-list.tsx:38
const barGlider: NavGliderProps = { $kind: "bar", $side: "end", $barOffset: "frame" };
```

- Measured (Chrome 154, port 4320, GET only, load average 51): the gallery sends 222 requests and requests 10 of its 20 card pictures in 3 of 3 loads. The directions page sends 221 requests and requests 6 pictures in 3 of 3 loads. No page has a frame. The list with 41 rows has 1 glider element.
- Counted: 20 picture files, 1,093,032 bytes. `src/lab/record.ts` has revision `r3`.
- Measured: `pnpm --filter @visonaut/lab typecheck` has no error.

**Two corrections that the document now states.**
- A card follows the theme control. The option text of D-PERF-03 says that it does not. I could not change the option text, so a paragraph after the panel and the end of the rationale say it.
- Counted from code: the component explorer has no frame. The settledAnswer of D-PERF-03 says that it keeps "their live frame". The paragraph after the panel says what the code has.

**One new limit that the document states.** D-PERF-01 is about the screenshot list only. The page links of the header and the run rows of the Queue and of History keep a hover glider, and nobody measured them.
